name: Blues Classics
description: Timeless blues standards that define the genre. From the Mississippi Delta to Chicago's South Side, these essential tracks shaped the foundation of modern music and continue to inspire generations of musicians across every style.

songs.title: Call It Stormy Monday (But Tuesday Is Just as Bad)
Dust My Broom
songs.album: Shake Your Moneymaker: The Best of the Fire Sessions

songs.title: Hide Away
songs.album: Let's Dance Away and Hide Away

songs.title: Cross Road Blues
songs.album: King of the Delta Blues Singers

name: Chicago Blues
description: Electric urban blues born in the Windy City. With its driving rhythms, amplified guitars, and powerful harmonica, Chicago blues brought the Delta sound north and electrified it for a new era, creating a blueprint for rock and roll.

songs.title: I Just Want to Make Love to You
I Just Want to Make Love to You

name: Delta Blues
description: Raw acoustic blues from the Mississippi Delta. Born from the cotton fields and juke joints of the Deep South, these haunting slide guitar and fingerpicked songs tell stories of hardship, love, and redemption with unflinching honesty.

songs.title: Hellhound on My Trail
songs.album: King of the Delta Blues Singers

name: Texas Blues
description: Lone Star blues with jazz-influenced guitar work. Texas blues pioneers blended swing, jazz, and jump blues into a sophisticated sound defined by clean single-note runs, behind-the-beat phrasing, and a soulful swagger that's unmistakably Southern.

name: Electric Blues
description: Amplified blues with powerful guitar and full band arrangements. Electric blues brought raw emotion and blistering solos to the forefront, paving the way for everything from British Invasion rock to modern blues-rock with its energetic, larger-than-life sound.

songs.title: What Kind Of Woman Is This?
Damn Right, I've Got the Blues
songs.album: Damn Right, I've Got the Blues

songs.title: I'm Tore Down
songs.album: Freddie King Is a Blues Master

songs.title: I'll Play the Blues for You (Parts 1 & 2)
songs.album: I'll Play the Blues for You

name: Acoustic Blues
description: Unplugged blues with raw vocal and guitar intimacy. Stripped down to the essentials, acoustic blues showcases the pure soul of the genre — just a voice, a guitar, and a story. These tracks highlight the delicate fingerwork and heartfelt delivery that started it all.

songs.title: Layla
songs.album: Layla and Other Assorted Love Songs

songs.title: Make Me a Pallet on Your Floor

name: British Blues
description: The UK's take on the blues tradition. When British musicians discovered American blues records in the 1960s, they ignited a transatlantic revolution. With grittier amplification and a raw energy, they reinterpreted the classics and introduced blues to a whole new generation.

songs.title: So Many Roads
songs.artist: John Mayall & The Bluesbreakers with Gary Moore

songs.title: Albatross
songs.album: The Pious Bird of Good Omen

songs.title: The Green Manalishi (With the Two Prong Crown)
I'd Love to Change the World

name: Blues Rock
description: Where blues meets rock and roll with explosive results. Blues rock fuses the soulful bends and shuffle rhythms of classic blues with the power chords, driving drums, and high-energy attitude of rock, creating an electrifying sound that fills stadiums.

name: Soul Blues
description: Blues with a deep soul and R&B influence that reaches the heart. Rich horn sections, gospel-tinged vocals, and lush arrangements define soul blues, where the emotional weight of the lyrics is carried by warm, full-bodied instrumentation and passionate delivery.

songs.title: I'll Play The Blues For You
I Put A Spell On You (Live)
Walk A Mile In My Shoes
songs.album: Walk a Mile in My Shoes

songs.title: Ain't No Love In The Heart Of The City
(Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay

name: Contemporary Blues
description: Modern blues for today's audience — fresh, relevant, and forward-looking. Contemporary blues artists honor the traditions while pushing boundaries with modern production, cross-genre collaborations, and lyrics that speak to current times, keeping the blues alive and evolving.

name: Blues Ballads
description: Slow, emotional, soul-stirring blues that linger long after the last note. Built around aching vocals, weeping guitar lines, and powerful minor-key progressions, blues ballads capture life's deepest emotions — heartbreak, longing, and quiet resilience.

songs.title: I Can't Make You Love Me

name: Blues Guitar Legends
description: Master guitarists who defined the blues sound with six strings and pure soul. From the bent-note crying of B.B. King to the fiery fretwork of Stevie Ray Vaughan, these virtuosos turned the guitar into a voice and set the standard for generations of players to come.

songs.title: Damn Right I've Got the Blues
songs.album: Damn Right I've Got the Blues

songs.title: Paying the Cost to Be the Boss

name: Live Blues
description: Blues captured in concert — raw and electrifying. There's nothing quite like the energy of live blues: the crowd's roar, the extended solos, the spontaneous interplay between musicians. These performances capture the magic that happens when blues takes the stage.

songs.title: Texas Flood (Live at the El Mocambo)
Layla (Live at Royal Albert Hall 1991)
songs.album: 24 Nights: Live at Royal Albert Hall

name: Americana Blues
description: Blues woven into the fabric of American roots music. Where blues meets folk, country, and Americana, this playlist celebrates the storytelling tradition of the heartland — acoustic-driven songs that echo from the Appalachian Mountains to the dusty roads of the rural South.

name: Blues Jam Sessions
description: Extended improvisations by blues masters stretching out and exploring. Jam sessions are where the magic happens — no setlists, no constraints, just phenomenal musicians trading licks, building tension, and taking the music to unexpected places in real time.

songs.title: Future Soul
songs.album: I Am the Moon: II. Ascension

songs.title: I Think You Know What I Mean

name: Rock Essentials
description: The definitive rock anthems that defined generations. From riff-driven classics to arena-shaking power chords, these essential tracks form the backbone of rock music history.

name: Jazz Standards
description: Timeless jazz masterpieces that shaped the genre. From smoky ballads to blazing bebop, these essential recordings capture the artistry and innovation of jazz's greatest performers.

songs.title: Feeling Good

name: Soul Classics
description: The sound of soul music at its finest. From Motown's golden era to the deep soul of Stax and Atlantic Records, these timeless tracks are the heartbeat of American music.

songs.title: I Was Made for Lovin' You
The Boys Are Back in Town

name: Heavy Metal
description: Dark, fast and heavy — thunderous riffs, blazing solos, and iconic vocals that forged the definitive sound of metal.

name: Psychedelic Rock
description: Trippy, experimental 60s rock built on fuzz guitars, sitars, and surreal lyrics — the soundtrack of the acid-fueled counterculture.

name: Southern Rock
description: Gritty blues-based rock from the American South, fueled by twin-guitar leads, boogie grooves, and honky-tonk swagger.

name: Glam Rock
description: Flamboyant, glitter-soaked early-70s rock defined by theatrical glamour, stomping boogie riffs, and outsized androgynous personas.

songs.title: This Town Ain't Big Enough for Both of Us

name: Punk Rock
description: A raw, fast, and defiantly amateurist eruption of mid-70s rebellion that stripped rock down to three chords, sneers, and slam-dunk anthems.

name: Grunge
description: The raw, sludge-soaked Seattle sound of the early 90s — heavy riffs, angsty howls, and the alt-rock revolution that changed everything.
